Drumskin Floor.name: Drumskin Floor
Drumskin Floor.description: The user slaps the floor and turns a whole room, a platform or a street-wide stretch of road into a heaving elastic surface for the rest of the scene. Enemies on it cannot run, charge or plant their feet for a heavy blow without being thrown off balance and knocked down, while the user and any allies they warn bounce across it at will. Strain: heavy.
